evidence.title: Zero — Human Infrastructure to Get Hired

name: Zero
summary: AI-native learning platform that trains people for in-demand careers through real projects and matched interviews.
description: Zero is an all-in-one app for getting hired into in-demand careers: software engineering, AI and data science, business, product, marketing and sales. Members build real projects and a portfolio inside immersive, AI-native experiences, and beta members get a guaranteed interview.
